auth_meta_description: Log in to your Dress Doctor account with a code sent to your WhatsApp or email.
auth_a11y_channel: How do you want to get your code?
auth_login_lead: Track your orders, manage your plan and book a pickup, all in one place.
auth_field_phone_hint: We will send a 6-digit code on WhatsApp.
auth_field_email_hint: We will send a 6-digit code to this email.
auth_code_leadWhatsapp: We sent a 6-digit code to {contact}. Enter it below to log in.
auth_code_leadEmail: We sent a 6-digit code to {contact}. Enter it below to log in.
auth_code_expired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
auth_resend_sent: A new code is on its way.
auth_error_codeWrong: That code is wrong or has run out. Check it, or ask for a new one.
auth_error_notFoundEmail: We cannot find a customer account with this email address.
auth_error_notFoundPhone: We cannot find a customer account with this number.
auth_error_inactive: This account is not active. Please contact us.
auth_error_locked: This account is locked for now. Please contact us.
auth_error_wait: Too many tries. Please wait {minutes} min, then try again.
auth_error_waitShort: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth_error_invalid: Please check your details and try again.
auth_error_network: We cannot reach Dress Doctor. Check your internet and try again.
auth_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth_note_loginWhatsapp: Your code comes to your WhatsApp chat with Dress Doctor. Save {phone} in your contacts so you can see it.
auth_note_loginEmail: Your code comes by email. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.
auth_note_codeWhatsapp: The code is in your WhatsApp chat with Dress Doctor. Save {phone} if you do not see it. Never share your code.
auth_note_codeEmail: Check your spam folder if the code does not arrive in a minute. Never share your code.
auth_aside_loginTitle: Free pickup. Expert care. Right to your door.
auth_aside_loginLead: Log in to follow an order, change your plan or book another pickup in under 30 seconds.
auth_aside_codeTitle: Almost there. Your laundry is waiting.
auth_aside_codeLead: Once you are in, you can follow an order, manage your plan or book another pickup in seconds.
auth_signup_error_rateLimited: Too many codes were asked for from this connection. Please try again later.
auth_signup_error_busy: We are very busy right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
auth_signup_error_numberHasAccount: This phone number already has an account. To use it, we need to send a code to this number on WhatsApp.
auth_signup_error_contactInUse: We cannot use these details to make an account. Please chat to us on WhatsApp and we will help.
auth_signup_error_sessionEnded: You were logged out. Please enter your details again.
auth_signup_error_sendRefused: We could not send your request.
auth_verify_leadWhatsapp: We sent a 6-digit code to {contact} on WhatsApp. Type it below.
auth_verify_leadEmail: We sent a 6-digit code to {contact} by email. Type it below.
auth_signup_chatMessage: Hello Dress Doctor, I could not make my account on the website. Can you help me?
